---
title: "Figure_2A_and_2B_disease_timecourse"
output: html_document
---

```{r}

library(ggpubr)
library(dplyr)
library(readr)

# Read the data (replace with your actual file path)
df <- read.csv("disease_timecourse.csv", header = TRUE)


# Summarise
df_summary <- df %>%
  group_by(treatment, day) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_pycnidia = mean(pycnidia_incidence),
    se_pycnidia = sd(pycnidia_incidence)/sqrt(n()),
    mean_necrosis = mean(necrosis_incidence),
    se_necrosis = sd(necrosis_incidence)/sqrt(n()),
    .groups = "drop"
  )


#Reorganise and relabel variables
df$treatment <- factor(
  df$treatment,
  levels = c(
    "mock",
    "IPO323",
    "∆AvrStb6"
  ),
  labels = c(
    "mock",
    "IPO323",
    "IPO323 ∆AvrStb6"
  )
)

#Subsetting specifc time points
df <- df %>%
  filter(day %in% c(3, 6, 9, 12, 15, 18, 21))


```

Pycnidia incidence

```{r}


# Pycnidia ggboxplot plot
ggboxplot(df, x = "day", y = "pycnidia_incidence",
          fill = "treatment",
          color = "treatment",
          add = "jitter",
          add.params = list(size = 2, alpha = 0.9),
          width = 0.7,
          alpha = 0.4,                    # transparency for boxes
          outlier.shape = NA) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 105)) +
  labs(x = "Time (dpi)",
       y = "Pycnidia incidence (%)",
       color = "Treatment",
       fill = "Treatment") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    text = element_text(family = "Avenir Next Medium")
  )



# Save last plot as a high-resolution PNG
ggsave("Figure_2A_Obelisk_pycnidia_incidence.png", width = 6, height = 4, dpi = 600)


```

Statistical analysis of data:

PYCNIDIA INCIDENCE:

ANOVA for pycnidia incidence

```{r}

library(dplyr)
library(rstatix)
library(openxlsx)

df_anova <- df %>%
  group_by(day) %>%
  filter(var(pycnidia_incidence, na.rm = TRUE) > 0) %>%
  ungroup()

anova_results <- df_anova %>%
  group_by(day) %>%
  anova_test(pycnidia_incidence ~ treatment)

anova_results

write.xlsx(
  anova_results,
  "anova_results_pycnidia.xlsx",
  overwrite = TRUE
)

```

Tukey for pycnidia incidence

```{r}

tukey_results <- df_anova %>%
  group_by(day) %>%
  tukey_hsd(pycnidia_incidence ~ treatment)

tukey_results

write.xlsx(
  tukey_results,
  "tukey_results_pycnidia.xlsx",
  overwrite = TRUE
)

```

Reduction of pycnidia incidence in the mutant ΔAvrStb6 compared to IPO323:=, using the following formula:

Reduction(%) = (Mean IPO323−Mean ΔAvrStb6)/Mean IPO323*100

```{r}

mean_incidence <- df %>%
  group_by(day, treatment) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_pycnidia = mean(pycnidia_incidence),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

reduction_table <- mean_incidence %>%
  filter(treatment %in% c("IPO323", "IPO323 ∆AvrStb6")) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = treatment,
    values_from = mean_pycnidia
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    difference = IPO323 - `IPO323 ∆AvrStb6`,
    reduction_percent = 100 * difference / IPO323
  )

#Restricting to significant time points only
sig_days <- tukey_results %>%
  filter(
    group1 == "IPO323" &
    group2 == "IPO323 ∆AvrStb6" &
    p.adj < 0.05
  ) %>%
  pull(day)

reduction_table_sig <- reduction_table %>%
  filter(day %in% sig_days)

reduction_table_sig

write.xlsx(
  reduction_table_sig,
  "pycnidia_incidence_reduction.xlsx",
  overwrite = TRUE
)



```
